prompts.title: 意大利餐馆的黄金时段肖像
prompts.description: 生成一张时尚年轻女性肖像的提示词，她坐在意大利户外餐馆里，正值黄金时段。提示词侧重于自然细节，例如波浪状的赤褐色头发、玳瑁太阳镜、米色丝绸衬衫，以及带有可见毛孔和雀斑的自然皮肤纹理。
prompts.content: Photorealistic portrait of a stylish young woman sitting at an outdoor Italian trattoria during golden hour. She has shoulder-length wavy auburn hair with soft texture and natural volume. She is wearing oversized round tortoiseshell sunglasses and a cream-colored silk blouse with a relaxed fit and slightly puffed sleeves. One hand is gently adjusting the sunglasses. Natural skin texture with visible pores and slight freckles, soft peachy makeup, defined brows, natural lips.

prompts.title: 与巨型毛绒猩猩的亲密合影
prompts.description: 一个详细的提示，用于生成一张亲密浪漫的肖像照：在极简主义的影棚环境中，一位拥有鲜艳红发和雀斑的美丽女子，身着深红色蕾丝内衣，头依偎在一只巨大的宜家 Djungelskog 毛绒猩猩上，戏剧性的暖色聚光灯投射出心形剪影，突出其美感。
prompts.content:
"In a minimalist studio setting, the scene overflows with an intimate and romantic atmosphere. A strikingly beautiful woman rests calmly on the floor, her head gently leaning against the chest of a large plush monkey. She has long, vibrant, curly red hair cascading around her, contrasting with her pale, dewy skin adorned with delicate freckles.

Her gaze is directed straight at the camera, accompanied by a gentle smile and flawless makeup: well-defined eyebrows, voluminous false eyelashes, and an intense red lipstick that harmonizes with her crimson lace lingerie and high-waisted garter belt.

Plush Monkey Details: Giant IKEA Djungelskog Orangutan stuffed orangutan (viral model), positioned on the left, dominating the frame.
Extremely soft, dense, and fluffy fur in warm rust-brown and chocolate-brown tones, with rich, voluminous texture and individual fibers catching the light.
The muzzle/face/ears/chest area features a lighter creamy-beige soft fleece.
Large rounded head, rounded embroidered black eyes, small dark embroidered nose, and a mouth with a soft, friendly expression.
Long, flexible arms and legs, with a highly huggable and cozy appearance.

Visual Elements and Atmosphere
Lighting and Setting: The background consists of a simple light-colored wall, brought to life by dramatic warm spotlights that project the silhouette of a heart just behind the pair, creating soft and cozy shadows.
Composition: The camera, positioned at a slightly low eye-level angle, uses a shallow depth of field to keep full focus on the woman and the plush monkey, leaving the background softly blurred.
Color Palette: Vibrant reds, earthy browns, and creamy hues dominate, reinforcing the warmth and coziness of the composition. Image size: 3:4."
prompts.translatedContent:
在一个极简主义的摄影棚场景中，弥漫着亲密而浪漫的氛围。一位惊艳的女性平静地躺在地板上，头轻轻地靠在一个巨大的毛绒猴子的胸口。她一头充满活力的红色卷发瀑布般垂下，与她苍白、水润、点缀着精致雀斑的肌肤形成对比。

她的目光直视镜头，带着温柔的微笑和无可挑剔的妆容：眉毛清晰分明，假睫毛浓密卷翘，鲜艳的红色口红与她深红色的蕾丝内衣和高腰吊袜带相得益彰。

毛绒猴子细节：巨大的 IKEA Djungelskog 猩猩毛绒玩具（网红款），位于画面左侧，占据主导地位。
极其柔软、浓密、蓬松的毛发，呈现温暖的锈棕色和巧克力棕色调，质感丰富饱满，每一根纤维都捕捉着光线。
口鼻/脸部/耳朵/胸部区域采用较浅的奶油米色柔软抓绒材质。
头部圆润，眼睛是圆形的刺绣黑色，鼻子是小小的深色刺绣，嘴巴带着柔和友善的表情。
四肢修长灵活，整体外观非常适合拥抱，给人舒适温暖的感觉。

视觉元素和氛围
灯光与布景：背景是一面简单的浅色墙壁，通过戏剧性的暖色聚光灯变得生动起来，聚光灯在两人身后投射出心形剪影，营造出柔和而舒适的阴影。
构图：相机以略低于视线的角度放置，采用浅景深，将焦点完全集中在女性和毛绒猴子身上，背景则柔和地虚化。
色彩搭配：鲜艳的红色、大地棕色和奶油色调占据主导，增强了构图的温暖和舒适感。图片尺寸：3:4。

prompts.title: ControlNet 约束下的逼真沙滩姿势
prompts.description: 一个高度技术性的提示，用于生成一张超逼真的海滩照片：一位年轻女性身穿黑色丁字裤比基尼，站在齐腰深的水中，摆出特定的扭曲姿势。该提示利用详细的 ControlNet 约束（OpenPose 和 MiDaS Depth）来确保解剖学和体积的准确性。
prompts.content:
{
  "subject": "Young adult female, tanned skin with water droplets and sand. Wet, wavy blonde hair gathered up. Wearing a black string bikini with thong bottom and thin straps. Gold watch on left wrist, small earring.",
  "pose": "Standing in waist-deep water, body facing away. Torso twisted right, head turned left looking down over shoulder in profile. Left arm raised, hand touching forehead. Right hand behind neck. Hips angled toward camera.",
  "environment": "Shallow turquoise ocean water over sandy bottom with sparse seagrass. Clear bright blue sky. Distinct horizon line. Distant parasail speck on right.",
  "camera": "Medium shot from mid-thigh up. Slightly above water level. Clear focus on subject, slight water refraction at bottom.",
  "lighting": "Bright, direct daylight. Strong specular highlights on wet skin, shoulders, and buttocks. Natural, high-contrast shadows defining physical form.",
  "mood_and_expression": "Relaxed, candid beach setting. Neutral, downward gaze.",
  "style_and_realism": "High-fidelity photograph, raw snapshot realism.",
  "colors_and_tone": "Vibrant natural colors. Deep blue sky, cyan water, bronze skin tone, black swimwear.",
  "quality_and_technical_details": "Sharp focus on subject. Visible texture of sand and water droplets on skin. Natural lighting and shadows.",
  "aspect_ratio_and_output": "3:4",
  "controlnet": {
    "pose_control": {
      "model_type": "openpose_full",
      "purpose": "Strictly lock skeletal alignment, anatomical proportions, torso orientation, and prevent structural or volumetric alteration",
      "constraints": "No limb length adjustment, no torso compression, no chest volume reduction, no posture change, no symmetry correction, no ribcage narrowing",
      "recommended_weight": 1.2
    },
    "depth_control": {
      "model_type": "depth_midas",
      "purpose": "Enforce exact volumetric projection, silhouette area equivalence, curvature depth integrity, and spatial layering",
      "constraints": "No depth flattening, no volumetric shrinkage, no perspective reinterpretation, no shadow softening, no foreground-background collapse",
      "recommended_weight": 1.25
    }
  },
  "negative_prompt": "stylization, aesthetic correction, body normalization, shape refinement, geometric reinterpretation, anatomical distortion, breast reduction, volume compression, torso slimming, ribcage narrowing, symmetry correction, proportion changes, depth flattening, shadow softening, beautification filters, perspective alteration"
}

prompts.content:
A surreal and ultra-realistic cinematic scene featuring a stylish young woman sliding down a smooth, flowing stream of glossy melted vanilla ice cream emerging from a giant cracked ice-cream sandwich.
The ice-cream sandwich is split into two large halves in the background, revealing layers of creamy vanilla ice cream, cookie crumbs, caramel ribbons, and crunchy nuts stretching and dripping downward.
The woman wears a beige bomber jacket, black jeans, black high-top sneakers, and dark sunglasses. She maintains a relaxed, confident pose while naturally sliding over the creamy flow like a soft slide in Gemini look.

prompts.translatedContent:
一个超现实、超逼真的电影场景：一位时尚的年轻女子正滑下由一个巨大的裂开的冰淇淋三明治中流淌出的光滑、浓稠的香草冰淇淋。
冰淇淋三明治在背景中裂成两半，露出了层层叠叠的奶油香草冰淇淋、饼干碎、焦糖丝带和松脆的坚果，它们向下延伸并滴落。
这位女子身穿米色飞行员夹克、黑色牛仔裤、黑色高帮运动鞋和深色太阳镜。她保持着放松、自信的姿态，像在 Gemini 广告中一样，自然地滑过奶油般的冰淇淋流。
融化的冰淇淋浓稠、有光泽，细节丰富，具有逼真的反光和质感。饼干表面光滑而浓郁，内部可见饼干碎屑。

果酱提示 👇
一个超现实、超逼真的场景：一位时尚的年轻女子正滑下由一个巨大的裂开的可颂面包中流淌出的光滑草莓酱。
可见的草莓块和酥脆的糕点层在两半之间延伸。
温暖的烘焙灯光，宏观纹理，电影般的景深，奢华甜点广告风格。
